issues.description: Basic usage example uses awkward `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` instead of direct indexing or name filter.
issues.detail: All six reviewers flagged this. `pipeline.nodes[0]` is clearer and idiomatic, or filter by name (`next(n for n in pipeline.nodes if n.name == 'train_model_node')`). The current pattern teaches a fragile habit since node ordering isn't guaranteed in multi-node pipelines.

issues.description: ImagePreview example has unreachable/commented code after a return statement.
issues.detail: All six reviewers flagged the `preview_correlation_matrix` example, where a commented-out data-URI return follows a live return. The structure misleads readers into thinking both returns coexist. Restructure as two separate example functions or an if/else branch.

issues.description: Several `node(...)` snippets appear at module level without a Pipeline wrapper.
issues.detail: Five reviewers flagged Mermaid customization, Text/code preview, and closure examples that show bare `node(func=..., preview_fn=...)` calls with no Pipeline context and reference undefined helpers like `process_data`. Copy-pasting fails. Wrap in `Pipeline([...])` or annotate as illustrative fragments.

issues.description: RELEASE.md entry missing for new experimental feature documentation.
issues.detail: Four reviewers noted the PR checklist leaves RELEASE.md unchecked. Since this documents a new public API surface (`preview_fn`, `preview_contract`), a short RELEASE.md bullet under docs/features aids discoverability. Confirm with maintainers whether the parent feature PR covers it.

issues.description: Lowercase `polars` added to ignore.txt duplicates existing `Polars` entry.
issues.detail: All six reviewers flagged this. If Vale's matcher is case-insensitive the second entry is redundant; if case-sensitive, fine but undocumented. Verify which applies, or capitalize `Polars` in the prose to avoid ignore-list churn.

issues.description: Double space before experimental link in warning admonition.
issues.detail: Two reviewers noted the warning reads `described in  [docs/about/experimental.md]` with two spaces before the link, visible in rendered output. Also verify the relative link resolves correctly from `docs/build/nodes.md`.

synthesis.summary: Documentation-only PR adding a substantial new section to `docs/build/nodes.md` covering the experimental `preview_fn` node feature, plus two minor Vale style config tweaks. Content is thorough and well-structured, but several code examples have copy-paste-safety issues that all six reviewers converged on: an awkward `next(n for n in pipeline.nodes)` idiom, an ImagePreview example with unreachable code after `return`, and multiple bare `node(...)` calls shown outside any Pipeline context. The Vale ignore list adds a redundant lowercase `polars` and the PR is missing a RELEASE.md entry for the new feature docs. No correctness or security concerns; safe to merge after example polish.
